name: systemic-risk-dashboard
description: Typed risk engine and modular sources; builds a self-contained GitHub Pages dashboard.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.browser.json && node scripts/build.mts
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.browser.json && node scripts/build.mts && node scripts/test.mts && node scripts/stamp.mts write
